newsitem.title: USA: BEFORE THE BELL - PanAmSat seen up at open.
newsitem.headline: BEFORE THE BELL - PanAmSat seen up at open.

text.p: Shares in PanAmSat Corp are expected to trade higher at Thursday's U.S. market open on news Hughes Electronics Corp imminently may announce a plan to combine its satellite system with PanAmSat Corp's satellite network, traders said.
Such a deal would create a global distributor of video, voice and data services as part of Hughes' expected $3-billion acquisition of PanAmSat, the Wall Street Journal reported Thursday.
After the news, PanAmSat shares were quoted at 27-3/4 bid, 27-1/2 ask, above yesterday's 26-3/4 Nasdaq close.
